title: Radiowelle: Radio & Webradio
subtitle: Free radio, no ads in the app
shortDescription: Free radio from Germany and the world. No ads in the app, no account needed.
promotionalText: More than 260 German stations built in, plus tens of thousands of stations worldwide. Free, no account, no ads in the app.
fullDescription:
Radiowelle is radio the way it should be: open the app, tap your station, listen. Free, no account and no ads in the app.

260+ GERMAN STATIONS BUILT IN
Every major German public and private station comes preinstalled with logo and a verified stream, from 1LIVE, SWR3, Bayern 3 and NDR 2 to Antenne Bayern, Deutschlandfunk, Klassik Radio, sunshine live and ROCK ANTENNE, plus local stations from all 16 German states.

THE WHOLE WORLD
Search tens of thousands of internet radio stations from over 200 countries by name, genre, city or country.

LIVE SONG TITLES
See what is playing right now and find the song in Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music or Deezer with one tap. Radiowelle keeps a private list of played songs so you can find them later.

MADE FOR EVERY DAY
- Save favorites and reorder them with drag and drop
- Skip through your favorites from the lock screen, headphones and your car via Bluetooth
- Sleep timer that fades the music out gently
- Automatic reconnect when your signal drops
- Light and dark mode
- Browse by German state and genre
- Available in 14 languages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no trackers, no ads in the app. Favorites, history and settings stay on your device.

Note: Radiowelle plays the public streams provided by the broadcasters. The programs themselves may contain the stations' own commercials. The station directory comes from the free community project radio-browser.info.

Radiowelle is made by Codext GmbH in Germany. Questions or a missing station? Email kontakt@codext.de.
